description: Third-party plugins to install via each platform's native plugin system

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Engineering skills by Matt Pocock (mattpocock/skills). Hybrid management: Claude uses the native plugin; Codex/Cursor use manual symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/.

claude.note: Native plugin is the sole source of mattpocock skills on Claude; this repo's plugin does not ship them (its root skills/ holds only self-owned skills). NOT installed by `install.py manual` on Claude.

codex.note: Installed by `install.py manual mattpocock-skills` — generates 27 symlinks into ~/.agents/skills/ (Codex standard user path) from the upstream plugin.json skill list. Codex follows symlinks per loader.rs (User scope = Follow). `install.py` does not prune stale links, so an upstream skill deletion leaves a dangling symlink to delete by hand.

cursor.note: Same as codex: `install.py manual mattpocock-skills` → ~/.agents/skills/. Cursor scans ~/.agents/skills/ by default and follows symlinks correctly.

plugins.name: understand-anything
plugins.description: AI-powered codebase understanding by EarthChen/Understand-Anything — analyze, visualize, and explain any project via an interactive knowledge graph. Multi-skill repo (11 skills) under understand-anything-plugin/skills/. Its plugin.json carries no `skills` list, so `install.py manual` discovers skills by scanning scan_dir for subdirs with a SKILL.md. Submodule at vendor/understand-anything stays out of build/_dist — no skills/ symlink.

claude.note: Installed by `install.py manual understand-anything` — symlinks each discovered skill into ~/.claude/skills/ (Claude scans this user-level dir; it does NOT read ~/.agents/skills/). Submodule at vendor/understand-anything; `git submodule update --remote` flows to all platforms at once.

plugins.name: answer-me-with-html
plugins.description: QingYunA/answer-me-with-html: renders a short extended-Markdown draft into a one-page HTML explainer. Used ONLY as the page backend of the self-owned skills/show-me, which reads the upstream SKILL.md (sections 2-7, with overrides) as its page manual and calls the bundled CLI at vendor/answer-me-with-html/skills/answer-me-with-html/scripts/am.mjs (~1MB single file, Node.js >= 20). The upstream skill is NOT linked: its description makes the model render a page for most answers and cuts the terminal reply to 2-3 lines. `install` has only `source`, so install.py inits the submodule and links nothing. Writes pages to ~/.answer-me-with-html/pages. Network: daily update check (raw.githubusercontent.com; disable with `am config set update_check false` or AM_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), theme catalog only on `am theme`, ElevenLabs only on `am video`. Never follow the CLI's `! Update hint` (`git pull && npm install`): upgrade via git submodule update --remote vendor/answer-me-with-html + re-pin to a release tag, then smoke-test `am render`. Do NOT install the upstream Claude plugin. Stays out of build/_dist.

claude.note: No skill link. skills/show-me runs the CLI through its wrapper skills/show-me/scripts/am (see CONTRIBUTING.md, answer-me-with-html).

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: MCP server + session-continuity layer by mksglu/context-mode. Saves context by sandboxing tool output (ctx_execute/ctx_execute_file/ctx_batch_execute/ctx_fetch_and_index/ctx_index/ctx_search) and tracking session events in FTS5-backed SQLite for restore across compactions. NOT a skill distributed by this repo — installed per-platform via each platform's native plugin or npm path. This repo's AGENTS.md already references ctx-* tools, so this entry formalizes their provenance.

claude.note: Auto-installed by install.py via `claude plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode` + `claude plugin install context-mode@context-mode --scope user`. Provides 11 MCP tools (6 sandbox + 5 meta) and all hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact/SessionStart/Stop) via the plugin's own manifest; routing is automatic via SessionStart hook. Requires Claude Code v1.0.33+. Verify with /context-mode:ctx-doctor.

codex.install_cmd: codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode  # then enable [features] plugin_hooks=true and hooks=true in ~/.codex/config.toml
codex.note: Codex native plugin (.codex-plugin/mcp.json + hooks.json + skills/). Plugin hooks are gated behind the plugin_hooks feature flag until Codex enables them by default; review and trust hooks when Codex prompts. Manual fallback (builds without plugin_hooks): pnpm add -g context-mode + [mcp_servers.context-mode] in ~/.codex/config.toml + ~/.codex/hooks.json — see README Codex CLI section.

cursor.note: Installed via Cursor marketplace (user-managed, not installed by this repo). Plugin auto-registers MCP + hooks (preToolUse/postToolUse/sessionStart/stop/afterAgentResponse) + rules + skills. Upstream README still lists marketplace as 'awaiting Cursor team review' (#485) with local-folder fallback, but install completed successfully via marketplace on this machine.

plugins.name: merman
plugins.description: Claude Code mod by iamrohithrnair/merman (TypeScript hooks that redraw replies; not a skill, tool or MCP server). Draws ```mermaid fences in the terminal as colored box art: flowchart/graph, sequence, state, class, ER, xychart-beta, pie, gantt, C4; a diagram over 80 lines or 8,000 characters, or wider than the window, stays as source. Also recolors tables, code and headings. skills/show-me relies on it for inline Mermaid in Claude Code. Needs Claude Code 2.1.311+, and installed mods only load when Claude Code's mod rollout switch is on for the account. No network. Keep `diagramHints` off (pluginConfigs["merman@merman"].options.diagramHints = false in ~/.claude/settings.json): when on, it adds ~355 tokens of drawing instructions to the model context per conversation, which overlap with skills/show-me. install.py does not write that setting. Upstream marketplace pins a release tag.

claude.note: Auto-installed by install.py via `claude plugin marketplace add iamrohithrnair/merman` + `claude plugin install merman@merman --scope user`. After install, set diagramHints to false by hand (settings.json pluginConfigs or `/plugin configure merman@merman`), then /reload-plugins. Verify with `/merman demo`: colored diagrams = mods load; 'installed mods are off for now' = the rollout switch is off, so uninstall it.
